description: This Java class 'MiniLangValidate' provides validation methods for a mini-language used within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to validate XML elements and attributes, handle errors, and check validation levels.

classes.name: MiniLangValidate
classes.description: Final class providing static validation methods for mini-language XML elements and attributes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: attributeNames
methods.description: Validates that the element's attribute names are within the set of valid attribute names.

methods.name: checkAttribute
methods.description: Returns attributeValue if not empty; otherwise returns defaultValue.

methods.name: childElements
methods.description: Validates that the element's child elements are within the set of valid child element names.

methods.name: constantAttributes
methods.description: Checks that specified attributes are constant (not expressions).

methods.name: constantPlusExpressionAttributes
methods.description: Checks that specified attributes are constant plus expression and do not contain scripts.

methods.name: deprecatedAttribute
methods.description: Checks for deprecated attributes and provides fix instructions.

methods.name: expressionAttributes
methods.description: Validates that specified attributes are of expression type and do not contain scripts.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles validation errors, throwing exceptions if strict, or logging warnings otherwise.

methods.name: lenientOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to lenient.

methods.name: noChildElements
methods.description: Ensures that the element has no child elements.

methods.name: requireAnyAttribute
methods.description: Ensures that at least one of the specified attributes is present.

methods.name: requireAnyChildElement
methods.description: Ensures that at least one of the specified child elements is present.

methods.name: requiredAttributes
methods.description: Ensures that all specified attributes are present.

methods.name: requiredChildElements
methods.description: Ensures that all specified child elements are present.

methods.name: scriptAttributes
methods.description: Validates that specified attributes contain scripts and are properly formatted.

methods.name: strictOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to strict.

methods.name: validationOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to lenient or strict.
